notes: Kakashi's kits (v9.6). Both are his eyes (the Sharingan, then both Mangekyo): his look stays, the kit clips show the red eyes, lightning and Kamui. The Lightning Hound, the Kamui swirl and the Susanoo ribcage are drawn by the game.

w0_jab2: second hit: his left eye glowing red with the Sharingan, a fast spinning back kick at chest height, then back into the stance
w0_jab3: finisher: thrusts his right palm straight forward crackling with a burst of blue lightning, a strong lightning palm strike, then back into the stance
w0_nair: air combo: a spinning kick in mid-air, then a second spinning kick the other way, his left eye glowing red, then back to the tucked pose
w0_sspecial: Lightning Hound: crouches and swings his right hand forward and down toward the ground, blue lightning crackling around the hand, then stands back into the stance. Only Kakashi is drawn: no hound, no lightning in front of him
w0_uspecial: Kamui warp: raises two fingers beside his glowing red Sharingan eye, his body twists and blurs as if pulled into a spiral, then he snaps back into the stance. Only Kakashi is drawn, visible in every frame: no vortex
w0_dspecial: Sharingan counter: crouches in a watchful guard, perfectly still, his red eye glowing, then sidesteps and strikes with a fast palm to the front, then back into the stance

w1_jab2: second hit: both eyes glowing red, a fast knee strike forward followed by a short elbow strike, then back into the stance
w1_jab3: finisher, Kamui Raikiri: thrusts his right hand straight forward crackling with purple-black lightning, then back into the stance
w1_nair: air combo: spins in mid-air, his right hand crackling with purple-black lightning sweeping around his body, then back to the tucked pose
w1_sspecial: Kamui Raikiri dash: crouches low, then dashes and stabs his right hand straight forward crackling with purple-black lightning, then returns to the stance
w1_uspecial: Susanoo leap: both eyes glowing red, he leaps straight up with one arm raised, purple lightning crackling around him, rising the whole time
w1_dspecial: Susanoo guard: braces with both forearms crossed in front of his face, both eyes glowing red, holds that guard, then returns to the stance. Only Kakashi is drawn: no Susanoo, no effect
